messages:
paul: Opening thread 3 recurring missing spans & aggregation drop focused on egress-batched uploads. Seen since 2026-04-28 midnight UTC.

paul: Symptom: aggregator shows window totals 2-4% lower; raw span store has the missing items. Pattern aligns with egress batching window closing early when downstream uploader stalls.

mina: any logs for uploader stalls?

jorge: snippet from uploader: ```
2026-04-28T00:12:08Z uploader-7 WARN flush-delay 118s
2026-04-28T00:12:09Z uploader-7 ERROR upload-failed: ConnectionReset
2026-04-28T00:12:09Z uploader-7 INFO retry scheduled
```

asha: if aggregator finalizes before the upload retry completes, those spans never get indexed. Short-term we should increase the egress flush timeout and add a reconciliation pass.

paul: proposed actions: (1) mina: metric "uploader.flush-delay_p95" + alert >30s for 10m. ETA: today EOD. (2) jorge: hotfix to extend flush timeout + safe retry (owner: jorge). ETA: PR tomorrow morning. (3) asha+paul: reconciliation job to diff raw-store vs index and emit backfills for last 48h. Spike this week. (4) monitor-bot: create ticket and weekly reminders.

monitor-bot: Created ticket INFR-5234: "Egress batching stall causes missing spans during flush". Assigned to @mina, @jorge, @asha.

mina: will add metric and dashboard tile; also create a small synthetic test to reproduce connection resets.

jorge: opening PR with timeout bump + exponential backoff retry for uploads. Includes unit tests. Link: https://git.internal/etl/uploader/pulls/211

asha: reconciliation plan: scan windows with delta >0.3% for last 48h and schedule idempotent backfills; will rate-limit to avoid load. Spike ETA: 3d.

paul: QA plan for hotfix: stage with injected connection resets, ensure aggregator includes spans after uploader retry, assert delta <0.2% for test windows.

monitor-bot: Scheduled weekly follow-ups on INFR-5234 for 4 weeks.

mina: metric live in staging; alert fired during synthetic test, working as expected.

jorge: PR merged to staging; running canary in staging cluster now.

paul: rolling canary to prod tonight: 10% -> 50% -> 100% if metrics look stable. Rollback if uploader.flush-delay_p95 > 45s or missing-span delta >0.5%.

asha: recon spike started; first backfill recovered ~1.6% of missing spans for a recent window.

paul: thanks all. I'll add a short postmortem to INFR-5234 and assign owners for follow-ups. Close this thread for active ops, comment for regressions. :white_check_mark:
